# Provisional Token Audit & Inventory

**Audited:** 19 August 2026 · **Auditor:** Marcel Navarro (FED Lead)
**Baseline:** `develop` @ `2dfeb4d` · **Working tree:** `feature/SFCC-55_global-footer-ui` @ `564ff99` + uncommitted rework
**Scope:** every raw design literal in `overrides/app/theme/components/**` and `overrides/app/components/**`

**Method — measured, not eyeballed:**

1. `overrides/app/theme/foundation/index.ts` bundled to CJS via `esbuild` and loaded at runtime, so token
   values are the **real evaluated values**, not regex guesses. Yields **76 distinct normalised values**
   across `colors`, `spacing`, `typography`, `sizes`, `gridSystem`, `motion`, and all 125 `zimmTokens` entries.
2. Every literal normalised to a common basis — lengths to px-equivalent (`rem`/`em` × 16), colours to
   canonical `rgba()`, durations to ms — so `3rem`, `48px` and `--zimm-scale-1200` compare as one value.
3. Cross-referenced with **semantic-scale compatibility** gating, so a width matching a breakpoint is
   reported as a coincidence rather than a false hit.
4. Scope split computed with `git grep` against `origin/develop` per constant.

> **Headline:** 29 raw design values across 10 files. Only **7** are true "missing token, value confirmed"
> cases. The rest are duplicates of existing tokens (5), conflicts with existing tokens (4), guessed
> values (~8), a framework token that already exists (1), and one plain DRY duplicate — **none of which a
> local-token system should absorb.**

---

## Summary

| Bucket | Count | Local token appropriate? | Action owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** — Already has an official token | 5 | ❌ delete the provisional | FED (2 free today) |
| **B** — Conflicts with an official token | 4 | ❌ needs a decision | UI Designer |
| **C** — Duplicate of another provisional | 1 pair | ❌ plain DRY fix | FED |
| **D1** — Missing token, **value confirmed** | 7 | ✅ **the target** | UI Designer |
| **D2** — Missing token, **value guessed** | ~8 | ❌ guess in token clothing | UI Designer (spec first) |
| **E** — Not a design gap at all | 1 | ❌ framework token exists | FED — **live defect** |

**Scope split:** ~15 introduced by PR #55, ~14 pre-existing on `develop`. Roughly half this backlog
predates the footer work and should not be attached to SFCC-55.

---

## A · Already has an official token — delete the provisional

| # | Provisional | Official token | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| A-1 | `BP.tablet = '48em'` — `theme/components/footer.ts:5` | **`breakpoints.md = '48em'`** | 🟢 exact, same unit |
| A-2 | `MARKER_SIZE = '16px'` — `components/contentful/experiences/hotspotMarker.tsx:25` | **`iconSizes.md = '16px'`** | 🟢 exact + same semantics (it *is* an icon) |
| A-3 | `SPACE_SECTION = '3rem'` — `footer.ts:12` | `--zimm-scale-1200 = '48px'` | 🟡 same value, **unit differs** |
| A-4 | `SIZE_COL_NAV = '8.75rem'` — `footer.ts:13` | `--zimm-scale-3500 = '140px'` | 🟡 same value, **unit differs** |
| A-5 | `w = '180px'` — `contentful/experiences/hotspotPopup.tsx:23` | `--zimm-scale-4500 = '180px'` | 🔴 numeric only — spacing scale used as a width |

### A-1 and A-2 are free deletions

`BP.tablet` is a byte-for-byte retype of `breakpoints.md`, and the code already admits it:

```ts
tablet: '48em', // Figma: alias/breakpoint/tablet — 768px (= Chakra theme.breakpoints.md)
```

Fix — importing a Tier 1 file is a *read*, not a modification, and matches the pattern `zimmTokens.ts` uses:

```diff
+ import { breakpoints } from '../foundation/gridSystem';

  const BP = {
-   tablet: '48em',
+   tablet: breakpoints.md,
    tabletWide: '53.75em',
    desktop: '64em',
  } as const;
```

### A-3 and A-4 — do NOT collapse downward

The values match but `footer.ts` uses `rem` where the foundation token uses `px`. These diverge under
browser zoom, and per `overrideStyling.md`'s Units rule (`rem` for anything that must scale, WCAG 1.4.4)
**`footer.ts` holds the correct form.** Collapsing to the existing var would swap correct behaviour for
incorrect. Correct action: keep the local, document the relationship, raise the *foundation* token to `rem`.

> This also contradicts `overrideStyling.md`, which states the 7 numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases are
> *"not duplicates, just Handover values with nothing to derive them from."* Two of them now have exact
> twins. That line needs updating — Tier 1 governance, so it is a flag, not an edit.

---

## B · Conflicts — a token exists and disagrees

**These must never become local tokens.** A local token here enshrines a value already known to be
contested, closes the story on a wrong pixel, and surfaces the defect later, further from its cause.

| # | Provisional | Official token | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-1 | `BTN_HEIGHT_LG = 50px` — `button.ts:193` | `actionSizes.height.lg = 52px` | −2px |
| B-2 | `BTN_HEIGHT_SM = 41px` — `button.ts:194` | `actionSizes.height.md = 40px` | +1px |
| B-3 | `NAV_LETTER_SPACING = 0.02em` — `navConstants.ts:5` | `textStyles.navigation` → `letterSpacings.sm = '0'` | +0.24px @ 12px |
| B-4 | `BP.desktop = 64em` (1024px) — `footer.ts:7` | `breakpoints.lg = 62em` (992px) / `xl = 80em` (1280px) | no clean mapping |

`navConstants.ts` documents its own conflict:

> *"The design system's `.zimm-text-nav` / `textStyles.navigation` both specify 0px — unresolved with the
> UI designer, so this prototype value is kept rather than silently switched."*

It additionally uses `em`, which `overrideStyling.md` restricts to breakpoints only — a unit-rule breach
on top of the value conflict.

**B-4 is the highest-impact:** because Figma's 1024px desktop maps to no Chakra breakpoint, every desktop
rule in `footer.ts` is written as a raw `@media (min-width: 64em)` and is unreachable via Chakra
responsive props. That shapes how the whole file is written, not just one value.

---

## C · Duplicate provisionals

### C-1 — True duplicate (intra-file)

`overrides/app/components/contentful/productHero.tsx`

```tsx
// :40 — loaded branch
boxSize={{ base: '240px', md: '320px' }}
// :46 — skeleton branch
boxSize={{ base: '240px', md: '320px' }}
```

Identical pair across two branches that must stay in sync, with nothing keeping them there. Should be one
constant regardless of any token work. **Pre-existing on `develop`.**

### C-2 — Cross-domain coincidences (NOT duplicates)

- `240px` × 4 — `heroBanner` height, `productHero` boxSize ×2, `header` minW
- `320px` × 3 — `footer` `SIZE_COL_SUB`, `productHero` boxSize ×2

Different domains sharing a number. Candidates for a future width scale; **not** evidence of a missing
shared token today. Recorded so they are not mistaken for findings later.

### C-3 — Rejected coincidence

`SIZE_MODAL_SUB = '30rem'` (480px) numerically equals `breakpoints.sm = '30em'` (480px). A modal max-width
is not a breakpoint. Excluded by the semantic gate — noted so a future naive grep does not "fix" it.

---

## D1 · Genuine gaps — value confirmed, token missing

**This is the true local-token target set.** Value is confirmed from Figma/Handover, so the rendered pixel
is already correct — QA passes, the story closes, and the eventual swap is cosmetic.

| # | Provisional | Value | Figma alias (already written in-code) | File |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1-1 | `SIZE_COL_SUB` | 320px | `alias/size/footer/col-width-subscribe` | `footer.ts:14` |
| D1-2 | `SIZE_COL_MAP` | 600px | `alias/size/footer/col-width-sitemap` | `footer.ts:15` |
| D1-3 | `SIZE_MODAL_SUB` | 480px | `alias/size/modal/footer` | `footer.ts:17` |
| D1-4 | `SIZE_SUB_BODY_MAX` | 200px | `alias/size/footer/subscribe-body-max` | `footer.ts:18` |
| D1-5 | `BP.tabletWide` | 860px | `alias/breakpoint/tablet-wide` | `footer.ts:6` |
| D1-6 | `COLOUR_HALF_INV` | `rgba(255,255,255,0.5)` | `alias/color/opacity-50-inverse` | `footer.ts:16` |
| D1-7 | `FIELD_CONTENT_HEIGHT` | 36px | `alias/size/field/height` | `zimmTextInput.ts:27` |

Two have **existing structure to extend rather than invent** — cheap asks:

- **D1-6** — `colors.opacity{15,30,40,50}` already exists but is grey-900-based only. The ask is the white
  twin, mirroring a structure that is already there.
- **`OPACITY_DISABLED = 0.4`** (`zimmTextInput.ts:29`) — the number already lives inside
  `colors.opacity[40]` as its alpha channel. What is missing is the **scalar form**, not the value.

**D1-7 is already documented on the design side.** Han Lee's F2R spec
(`f2r/02-design/specs/components/text-input.md`, branch `feature/f2r-component-registry`) lists it under
*"Structural measurements (not in named token scale)"*:

> - Content area height: **36px** (Figma `h-[36px]` on `.content`)
> - Input container height: 20px
> - Border row min-height: 44px

The designer has already identified it as a non-token and published the confirmed value. There is simply no
link between his line and ours. ⚠️ **`f2r/` is not on `develop`** — that branch is 360 files / 31k
insertions, unmerged, so this join is available in principle but not yet a shared dependency.

---

## D2 · Guessed values — should NOT become local tokens

No Figma alias, no confirmed source. A local token here is a guess wearing a token's clothes: it looks
resolved, tracks as resolved, and is wrong.

| Provisional | Value | File | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BTN_PADDING_Y` | 5px | `button.ts:195` | `overrideStyling.md` admits *"no Handover token at all"* |
| `LOGO_MAX_WIDTH` | 327px | `ui-kits/atoms/zimmLogo/index.tsx:12` | explicitly marked `// provisional` |
| `LOGO_HEIGHT` | 39px | `zimmLogo/index.tsx:13` | explicitly marked `// provisional` |
| `height.md` | 400px | `contentful/heroBanner.tsx:23` | Contentful scaffolding |
| `h` | 120px | `contentful/experiences/hotspotPopup.tsx:30` | Contentful scaffolding |
| `height.base` | 240px | `contentful/heroBanner.tsx:23` | see C-2 |
| `boxSize` | 240/320px | `contentful/productHero.tsx:40,46` | see C-1 |
| `minW` | 240px | `header/index.tsx:229` | see C-2 |

**These need a spec before they need a token.** The correct route is a design request, not a placeholder.

---

## E · Not a design gap — live defect

**`MODAL_Z_INDEX = 1000`** — `theme/components/footer.ts:19`, applied at `modalOverlay` (`:146`)

This is not a designer dependency. Chakra already ships the semantic tokens:

```
dropdown: 1000 · sticky: 1100 · banner: 1200 · overlay: 1300 · modal: 1400 · toast: 1700
```

**The defect:** `header.ts:28-30` sets `position: sticky; zIndex: 'sticky'` → **1100**. The footer's
subscribe-modal overlay is `position: fixed; inset: 0; zIndex: 1000`.

Verified there is no rescuing stacking context — `footer.ts` contains no `transform`, `opacity`, `filter`,
`isolation` or other `zIndex` anywhere, the root container is only `backgroundColor` + `width`, and the
modal is `createPortal`'d to `document.body`. The overlay competes with the header directly in the root
stacking context **and loses**.

**Result:** opening the footer subscribe modal leaves the sticky header painted above the dimmed backdrop,
visible and clickable, with focus able to reach header links behind the modal.

`1000` is also *exactly* Chakra's `dropdown` value — a strong signal it was picked by guess. The in-code
comment claims *"above all page content; below toasts/notifications"*; it is in fact below seven of the
thirteen layers.

**Fix — no designer needed, the tokens already exist:**

```diff
- const MODAL_Z_INDEX = 1000;
  modalOverlay: {
-   zIndex: MODAL_Z_INDEX,
+   zIndex: 'overlay',   // 1300 — above sticky header (1100) and banner (1200)
  },
  subscribeModalPanel: {
+   zIndex: 'modal',     // 1400 — panel above its own overlay
```

This *removes* a provisional rather than parking it. Sev3-class against the SOW bar (≤10 defects, no Sev3).

---

## Scope split — PR #55 vs inherited

| Introduced by PR #55 (~15) | Pre-existing on `develop` (~14) |
|---|---|
| `BP.tablet` / `tabletWide` / `desktop` | `BTN_HEIGHT_LG` / `BTN_HEIGHT_SM` / `BTN_PADDING_Y` |
| `SPACE_SECTION`, `SIZE_COL_NAV`, `SIZE_COL_SUB`, `SIZE_COL_MAP` | `NAV_LETTER_SPACING` |
| `COLOUR_HALF_INV`, `SIZE_MODAL_SUB`, `SIZE_SUB_BODY_MAX` | `heroBanner`, `productHero`, `hotspotPopup`, `hotspotMarker` literals |
| `MODAL_Z_INDEX` | `header/index.tsx` `minW` |
| `FIELD_CONTENT_HEIGHT`, `OPACITY_DISABLED` | |
| `LOGO_MAX_WIDTH`, `LOGO_HEIGHT` | |

---

## Recommended actions

### Now — no designer, no Tier 1 approval

| # | Action | File |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `MODAL_Z_INDEX` → Chakra `overlay` / `modal` tokens (**live defect**) | `theme/components/footer.ts` |
| 2 | `BP.tablet` → `import { breakpoints }` (A-1) | `theme/components/footer.ts` |
| 3 | `MARKER_SIZE` → `iconSizes.md` (A-2) | `hotspotMarker.tsx` |
| 4 | Comment the A-3/A-4 unit relationship so the rem-vs-px choice is deliberate, not accidental | `theme/components/footer.ts` |
| 5 | Extract the duplicated `boxSize` pair to one constant (C-1) | `productHero.tsx` |

Items 3 and 5 are outside SFCC-55's scope — raise as a separate tidy-up rather than widening this PR.

### Raise to UI Designer (Kiera)

- **D1 (7 items)** — confirmed values needing token names. Cheapest wins: `alias/color/opacity-50-inverse`
  (mirrors existing `colors.opacity` structure) and `alias/size/field/height` (**already in Han's spec**).
- **B (4 items)** — conflicts requiring a decision, not a placeholder. **B-4 (`BP.desktop`) first** — it
  shapes how every responsive rule in `footer.ts` is written.
- **D2 (~8 items)** — need a design spec before a token.

### Backlog / governance

- Write `scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`. `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` instructs developers to run it
  before any PR touching `theme/components/**` — **it does not exist.** That is a large part of why 29
  literals accumulated unnoticed.
- Correct `overrideStyling.md`'s *"the numeric aliases are not duplicates"* claim (Tier 1 governance).
- Decide with Tim whether a Tier 2 file may **declare** a `--zimm-*` custom property. No file does today.
  It would make closing a local token a one-line delete instead of a find-and-replace — but a stale local
  would **silently shadow** the real `:root` token once it lands, so it is only safe alongside the audit script.

---

## What this says about the local-token proposal

The audit resizes the idea: **~7 of 29 (a quarter) are true local-token candidates**, not the ~60% first
estimated. The system is still worth building, but its primary value is now clearer:

> **The audit is the product.** Two-thirds of what looked like "waiting on the designer" turned out to be
> duplicates of existing tokens, conflicts with existing tokens, guesses, or already-solved by the
> framework — and none of that was visible while the only marker was a prose comment.

The structural defect in today's setup is that `const MOTION = 'var(--zimm-motion-duration-fast) …'`
(correct — references a real token) and `const FIELD_CONTENT_HEIGHT = '36px'` (a designer dependency) are
**syntactically identical**. Nothing can tell them apart mechanically. That is what lets these reach
`develop` unnoticed, and it is what a structured marker plus a generated registry would fix.

---

*Generated from a scripted cross-reference, not manual inspection. Re-runnable: bundle
`foundation/index.ts` with esbuild, normalise all literals to px-equivalent/canonical-rgba, and gate
matches on semantic scale compatibility.*

+   tablet: breakpoints.md,
    tabletWide: '53.75em',
    desktop: '64em',
  } as const;
```

### A-3 and A-4 — do NOT collapse downward

The values match but `footer.ts` uses `rem` where the foundation token uses `px`. These diverge under
browser zoom, and per `overrideStyling.md`'s Units rule (`rem` for anything that must scale, WCAG 1.4.4)
**`footer.ts` holds the correct form.** Collapsing to the existing var would swap correct behaviour for
incorrect. Correct action: keep the local, document the relationship, raise the *foundation* token to `rem`.

> This also contradicts `overrideStyling.md`, which states the 7 numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases are
> *"not duplicates, just Handover values with nothing to derive them from."* Two of them now have exact
> twins. That line needs updating — Tier 1 governance, so it is a flag, not an edit.

---

## B · Conflicts — a token exists and disagrees

**These must never become local tokens.** A local token here enshrines a value already known to be
contested, closes the story on a wrong pixel, and surfaces the defect later, further from its cause.

| # | Provisional | Official token | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-1 | `BTN_HEIGHT_LG = 50px` — `button.ts:193` | `actionSizes.height.lg = 52px` | −2px |
| B-2 | `BTN_HEIGHT_SM = 41px` — `button.ts:194` | `actionSizes.height.md = 40px` | +1px |
| B-3 | `NAV_LETTER_SPACING = 0.02em` — `navConstants.ts:5` | `textStyles.navigation` → `letterSpacings.sm = '0'` | +0.24px @ 12px |
| B-4 | `BP.desktop = 64em` (1024px) — `footer.ts:7` | `breakpoints.lg = 62em` (992px) / `xl = 80em` (1280px) | no clean mapping |

`navConstants.ts` documents its own conflict:

> *"The design system's `.zimm-text-nav` / `textStyles.navigation` both specify 0px — unresolved with the
> UI designer, so this prototype value is kept rather than silently switched."*

It additionally uses `em`, which `overrideStyling.md` restricts to breakpoints only — a unit-rule breach
on top of the value conflict.

**B-4 is the highest-impact:** because Figma's 1024px desktop maps to no Chakra breakpoint, every desktop
rule in `footer.ts` is written as a raw `@media (min-width: 64em)` and is unreachable via Chakra
responsive props. That shapes how the whole file is written, not just one value.

---

## C · Duplicate provisionals

### C-1 — True duplicate (intra-file)

`overrides/app/components/contentful/productHero.tsx`

```tsx
// :40 — loaded branch
boxSize={{ base: '240px', md: '320px' }}
// :46 — skeleton branch
boxSize={{ base: '240px', md: '320px' }}
```

Identical pair across two branches that must stay in sync, with nothing keeping them there. Should be one
constant regardless of any token work. **Pre-existing on `develop`.**

### C-2 — Cross-domain coincidences (NOT duplicates)

- `240px` × 4 — `heroBanner` height, `productHero` boxSize ×2, `header` minW
- `320px` × 3 — `footer` `SIZE_COL_SUB`, `productHero` boxSize ×2

Different domains sharing a number. Candidates for a future width scale; **not** evidence of a missing
shared token today. Recorded so they are not mistaken for findings later.

### C-3 — Rejected coincidence

`SIZE_MODAL_SUB = '30rem'` (480px) numerically equals `breakpoints.sm = '30em'` (480px). A modal max-width
is not a breakpoint. Excluded by the semantic gate — noted so a future naive grep does not "fix" it.

---

## D1 · Genuine gaps — value confirmed, token missing

**This is the true local-token target set.** Value is confirmed from Figma/Handover, so the rendered pixel
is already correct — QA passes, the story closes, and the eventual swap is cosmetic.

| # | Provisional | Value | Figma alias (already written in-code) | File |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1-1 | `SIZE_COL_SUB` | 320px | `alias/size/footer/col-width-subscribe` | `footer.ts:14` |
| D1-2 | `SIZE_COL_MAP` | 600px | `alias/size/footer/col-width-sitemap` | `footer.ts:15` |
| D1-3 | `SIZE_MODAL_SUB` | 480px | `alias/size/modal/footer` | `footer.ts:17` |
| D1-4 | `SIZE_SUB_BODY_MAX` | 200px | `alias/size/footer/subscribe-body-max` | `footer.ts:18` |
| D1-5 | `BP.tabletWide` | 860px | `alias/breakpoint/tablet-wide` | `footer.ts:6` |
| D1-6 | `COLOUR_HALF_INV` | `rgba(255,255,255,0.5)` | `alias/color/opacity-50-inverse` | `footer.ts:16` |
| D1-7 | `FIELD_CONTENT_HEIGHT` | 36px | `alias/size/field/height` | `zimmTextInput.ts:27` |

Two have **existing structure to extend rather than invent** — cheap asks:

- **D1-6** — `colors.opacity{15,30,40,50}` already exists but is grey-900-based only. The ask is the white
  twin, mirroring a structure that is already there.
- **`OPACITY_DISABLED = 0.4`** (`zimmTextInput.ts:29`) — the number already lives inside
  `colors.opacity[40]` as its alpha channel. What is missing is the **scalar form**, not the value.

**D1-7 is already documented on the design side.** Han Lee's F2R spec
(`f2r/02-design/specs/components/text-input.md`, branch `feature/f2r-component-registry`) lists it under
*"Structural measurements (not in named token scale)"*:

> - Content area height: **36px** (Figma `h-[36px]` on `.content`)
> - Input container height: 20px
> - Border row min-height: 44px

The designer has already identified it as a non-token and published the confirmed value. There is simply no
link between his line and ours. ⚠️ **`f2r/` is not on `develop`** — that branch is 360 files / 31k
insertions, unmerged, so this join is available in principle but not yet a shared dependency.

---

## D2 · Guessed values — should NOT become local tokens

No Figma alias, no confirmed source. A local token here is a guess wearing a token's clothes: it looks
resolved, tracks as resolved, and is wrong.

| Provisional | Value | File | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BTN_PADDING_Y` | 5px | `button.ts:195` | `overrideStyling.md` admits *"no Handover token at all"* |
| `LOGO_MAX_WIDTH` | 327px | `ui-kits/atoms/zimmLogo/index.tsx:12` | explicitly marked `// provisional` |
| `LOGO_HEIGHT` | 39px | `zimmLogo/index.tsx:13` | explicitly marked `// provisional` |
| `height.md` | 400px | `contentful/heroBanner.tsx:23` | Contentful scaffolding |
| `h` | 120px | `contentful/experiences/hotspotPopup.tsx:30` | Contentful scaffolding |
| `height.base` | 240px | `contentful/heroBanner.tsx:23` | see C-2 |
| `boxSize` | 240/320px | `contentful/productHero.tsx:40,46` | see C-1 |
| `minW` | 240px | `header/index.tsx:229` | see C-2 |

**These need a spec before they need a token.** The correct route is a design request, not a placeholder.

---

## E · Not a design gap — live defect

**`MODAL_Z_INDEX = 1000`** — `theme/components/footer.ts:19`, applied at `modalOverlay` (`:146`)

This is not a designer dependency. Chakra already ships the semantic tokens:

```
dropdown: 1000 · sticky: 1100 · banner: 1200 · overlay: 1300 · modal: 1400 · toast: 1700
```

**The defect:** `header.ts:28-30` sets `position: sticky; zIndex: 'sticky'` → **1100**. The footer's
subscribe-modal overlay is `position: fixed; inset: 0; zIndex: 1000`.

Verified there is no rescuing stacking context — `footer.ts` contains no `transform`, `opacity`, `filter`,
`isolation` or other `zIndex` anywhere, the root container is only `backgroundColor` + `width`, and the
modal is `createPortal`'d to `document.body`. The overlay competes with the header directly in the root
stacking context **and loses**.

**Result:** opening the footer subscribe modal leaves the sticky header painted above the dimmed backdrop,
visible and clickable, with focus able to reach header links behind the modal.

`1000` is also *exactly* Chakra's `dropdown` value — a strong signal it was picked by guess. The in-code
comment claims *"above all page content; below toasts/notifications"*; it is in fact below seven of the
thirteen layers.

**Fix — no designer needed, the tokens already exist:**

```diff
- const MODAL_Z_INDEX = 1000;
  modalOverlay: {
-   zIndex: MODAL_Z_INDEX,
+   zIndex: 'overlay',   // 1300 — above sticky header (1100) and banner (1200)
  },
  subscribeModalPanel: {
+   zIndex: 'modal',     // 1400 — panel above its own overlay
```

This *removes* a provisional rather than parking it. Sev3-class against the SOW bar (≤10 defects, no Sev3).

---

## Scope split — PR #55 vs inherited

| Introduced by PR #55 (~15) | Pre-existing on `develop` (~14) |
|---|---|
| `BP.tablet` / `tabletWide` / `desktop` | `BTN_HEIGHT_LG` / `BTN_HEIGHT_SM` / `BTN_PADDING_Y` |
| `SPACE_SECTION`, `SIZE_COL_NAV`, `SIZE_COL_SUB`, `SIZE_COL_MAP` | `NAV_LETTER_SPACING` |
| `COLOUR_HALF_INV`, `SIZE_MODAL_SUB`, `SIZE_SUB_BODY_MAX` | `heroBanner`, `productHero`, `hotspotPopup`, `hotspotMarker` literals |
| `MODAL_Z_INDEX` | `header/index.tsx` `minW` |
| `FIELD_CONTENT_HEIGHT`, `OPACITY_DISABLED` | |
| `LOGO_MAX_WIDTH`, `LOGO_HEIGHT` | |

---

## Recommended actions

### Now — no designer, no Tier 1 approval

| # | Action | File |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `MODAL_Z_INDEX` → Chakra `overlay` / `modal` tokens (**live defect**) | `theme/components/footer.ts` |
| 2 | `BP.tablet` → `import { breakpoints }` (A-1) | `theme/components/footer.ts` |
| 3 | `MARKER_SIZE` → `iconSizes.md` (A-2) | `hotspotMarker.tsx` |
| 4 | Comment the A-3/A-4 unit relationship so the rem-vs-px choice is deliberate, not accidental | `theme/components/footer.ts` |
| 5 | Extract the duplicated `boxSize` pair to one constant (C-1) | `productHero.tsx` |

Items 3 and 5 are outside SFCC-55's scope — raise as a separate tidy-up rather than widening this PR.

### Raise to UI Designer (Kiera)

- **D1 (7 items)** — confirmed values needing token names. Cheapest wins: `alias/color/opacity-50-inverse`
  (mirrors existing `colors.opacity` structure) and `alias/size/field/height` (**already in Han's spec**).
- **B (4 items)** — conflicts requiring a decision, not a placeholder. **B-4 (`BP.desktop`) first** — it
  shapes how every responsive rule in `footer.ts` is written.
- **D2 (~8 items)** — need a design spec before a token.

### Backlog / governance

- Write `scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`. `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` instructs developers to run it
  before any PR touching `theme/components/**` — **it does not exist.** That is a large part of why 29
  literals accumulated unnoticed.
- Correct `overrideStyling.md`'s *"the numeric aliases are not duplicates"* claim (Tier 1 governance).
- Decide with Tim whether a Tier 2 file may **declare** a `--zimm-*` custom property. No file does today.
  It would make closing a local token a one-line delete instead of a find-and-replace — but a stale local
  would **silently shadow** the real `:root` token once it lands, so it is only safe alongside the audit script.

---

## What this says about the local-token proposal

The audit resizes the idea: **~7 of 29 (a quarter) are true local-token candidates**, not the ~60% first
estimated. The system is still worth building, but its primary value is now clearer:

> **The audit is the product.** Two-thirds of what looked like "waiting on the designer" turned out to be
> duplicates of existing tokens, conflicts with existing tokens, guesses, or already-solved by the
> framework — and none of that was visible while the only marker was a prose comment.

The structural defect in today's setup is that `const MOTION = 'var(--zimm-motion-duration-fast) …'`
(correct — references a real token) and `const FIELD_CONTENT_HEIGHT = '36px'` (a designer dependency) are
**syntactically identical**. Nothing can tell them apart mechanically. That is what lets these reach
`develop` unnoticed, and it is what a structured marker plus a generated registry would fix.

---

And while checking scope for your question, I found something that changes the answer slightly:

## PR #55 currently touches Tier 1

```
commit d83d20c — overrides/app/theme/foundation/sizes.ts | 1 +
```

It's a **trailing blank line**. No value change. But it puts `foundation/` in the PR diff, which triggers CODEOWNERS auto-request to `@ZimmermannAU/tier-1-approvers` and a `tier1-guard` warning on the PR — for a newline. Your working tree has already reverted it; it just needs committing so the file drops out of the diff.

---

# Split it three ways

## ✅ Belongs in PR #55 — it's the PR's own code

| Item | Why |
|---|---|
| **E — `MODAL_Z_INDEX` → `overlay`/`modal`** | Not a token concern at all. A **Sev3-class defect introduced by this PR**: the sticky header paints over the subscribe modal. Ships broken otherwise. |
| **A-1 — `BP.tablet` → `breakpoints.md`** | Introduced by #55, 3 lines, same file, zero risk. Cheaper to fix than to track. |
| **A-3/A-4 — comment the rem-vs-px relationship** | Comment-only. Makes a deliberate choice look deliberate. |
| **Drop the stray `sizes.ts` newline** | Removes Tier 1 from the diff entirely. |

None of these need a designer, none need Tier 1 approval, all are in files #55 already owns.

## 🚫 Cannot be in PR #55 — needs a designer

**D1 (7 confirmed-value gaps) and B (4 conflicts).**

Creating a token means editing `foundation/` — **Tier 1**. AGENTS.md Hard Rule #10 forbids spanning protection tiers without confirming scope, and #55 is a Tier 2 feature PR.

More importantly: **these don't block shipping.** Every D1 value renders the correct pixel — the token name is missing, not the value. Nothing is visually wrong.

This isn't a PR. It's a **designer request plus a tracked list** — the audit doc is that list.

## 🚫 Should not be in PR #55 — pre-existing, other files

**A-2, A-5, C-1, C-2, and the D2 Contentful/header literals** — `hotspotMarker.tsx`, `hotspotPopup.tsx`, `productHero.tsx`, `heroBanner.tsx`, `header/index.tsx`. All identical to `develop`; #55 hasn't touched them.

Fixing them here violates two rules directly:
- **Hard Rule #5** — *"Never refactor upward"*
- **Minimal changes** — *"the smallest change that fully achieves the task"*

It would also drag `contentful/` and `header/` into a footer PR's review surface, pulling in Squad ownership that doesn't belong there.

→ **Separate tidy-up PR**, no story attached.

---

# Recommendation

**Ship PR #55 with the four ✅ items. Nothing else.**

The audit's own numbers back this: of 29 findings, exactly **one** blocks shipping — and it's a z-index bug, not a token gap. The 7 genuine designer dependencies all render correctly today; they're a tracking problem, not a release problem.

That gives you three clean tracks:

| Track | Contents | Vehicle |
|---|---|---|
| **1 — Now** | z-index fix, `BP.tablet`, 2 comments, Tier 1 newline | **PR #55** |
| **2 — Designer** | D1 (7 tokens) + B (4 decisions) + D2 (8 specs) | Kiera ask, audit doc as the artefact |
| **3 — Tidy-up** | A-2, A-5, C-1, C-2 in Contentful/header | Separate PR, no story |

The local-token *system* itself (markers, generated registry, `auditTokenUsage.mjs`) is a fourth track — tooling and governance, and definitely not this PR.

All four verified. One of them needs a decision from you first — here's the current vs changed for each.

---

# 1 · Z-index defect — `footer.ts`

**Current** (line 19, and line 146 in `modalOverlay`):

```ts
const MODAL_Z_INDEX = 1000; // above all page content; below toasts/notifications
```
```ts
modalOverlay: {
  position: 'fixed',
  inset: 0,
  background: 'var(--zimm-color-opacity-50)',
  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
  padding: 'l',
  zIndex: MODAL_Z_INDEX,        // 1000 — loses to header's 1100
},
```

**Changed:**

```diff
- const MODAL_Z_INDEX = 1000; // above all page content; below toasts/notifications
```
```diff
  modalOverlay: {
    position: 'fixed',
    inset: 0,
    ...
    padding: 'l',
-   zIndex: MODAL_Z_INDEX,
+   // Chakra zIndices.overlay (1300). Must clear the sticky header, which sets
+   // zIndex: 'sticky' (1100) in header.ts. The portal target is document.body,
+   // so this competes in the root stacking context, not the footer's.
+   zIndex: 'overlay',
  },
```

**Correction to what I proposed earlier:** I also suggested `zIndex: 'modal'` on `subscribeModalPanel`. I checked — the panel is a **static-positioned descendant** of the overlay, and the overlay's `zIndex` creates a stacking context, so the panel already paints above its parent's background. That extra line would be a no-op. Dropping it.

---

# 2 · `BP.tablet` — needs your call

**Current** (lines 1–8):

```ts
// Provisional breakpoint values — no confirmed foundation token yet.
// Replace with foundation/gridSystem.ts imports once the UI designer confirms the tokens.
const BP = {
  tablet: '48em',      // = Chakra theme.breakpoints.md   ← the comment admits the duplicate
  tabletWide: '53.75em',
  desktop: '64em',
} as const;
```

The header comment is **false for `tablet`** — `breakpoints.md` is exactly `'48em'` and confirmed.

I checked whether importing it is clean, and hit a constraint: **no file in `theme/components/` imports from `foundation/`.** That's a deliberate convention (`projectState.md`: *"header.ts/listMenu.ts brought onto the same `var(--zimm-*)` convention — no direct `foundation/` imports"*). This would be the first.

### Option A — import it (removes the duplicate)

```diff
+ import { breakpoints } from '../foundation/gridSystem';
+
- // Provisional breakpoint values — no confirmed foundation token yet.
- // Replace with foundation/gridSystem.ts imports once the UI designer confirms the tokens.
+ // tablet mirrors the confirmed foundation breakpoint. tabletWide/desktop have no
+ // foundation equivalent yet — see the provisional-token audit (B-4, D1-5).
+ // Breakpoints cannot go through --zimm-* CSS vars: media queries don't accept var().
  const BP = {
-   tablet: '48em',
+   tablet: breakpoints.md,
    tabletWide: '53.75em',
    desktop: '64em',
  } as const;
```

**The convention's rationale doesn't actually apply here** — it exists so values flow through `zimmTokens` → CSS vars as one publication path, but media queries structurally cannot consume `var()`. So breakpoints are a genuine exception, not a breach of intent. Still, it sets a precedent.

### Option B — comment only (leaves the duplicate)

```diff
- // Provisional breakpoint values — no confirmed foundation token yet.
- // Replace with foundation/gridSystem.ts imports once the UI designer confirms the tokens.
+ // tablet duplicates the confirmed foundation token breakpoints.md ('48em') — kept as a
+ // literal because theme/components/ does not import from foundation/, and media queries
+ // cannot consume --zimm-* vars. tabletWide/desktop have no foundation equivalent.
```

Zero risk, no precedent, but two values that can still disagree.

**My recommendation: A.** It's the only one that actually removes the duplicate, and the exception is principled. But it's your convention to set — say the word if you'd rather take B.

---

# 3 · Unit-relationship comments — `footer.ts:12-13`

**Current:**

```ts
// Provisional spacing/size values — kept here as named references until the UI designer
// confirms the token in foundation/spacing.ts or foundation/sizes.ts.
const SPACE_SECTION = '3rem';    // alias/space/section (48px)
const SIZE_COL_NAV = '8.75rem';  // alias/size/footer/col-width-nav (140px)
```

Reads as "no token exists." In fact both values **already exist** in `zimmTokens.ts` — as `px`.

**Changed:**

```diff
  // Provisional spacing/size values — kept here as named references until the UI designer
  // confirms the token in foundation/spacing.ts or foundation/sizes.ts.
+ //
+ // SPACE_SECTION and SIZE_COL_NAV are NOT missing tokens: --zimm-scale-1200 (48px) and
+ // --zimm-scale-3500 (140px) carry the same values. They are deliberately kept as rem
+ // here — those two foundation aliases are px, which does not scale under browser zoom
+ // (WCAG 1.4.4, overrideStyling.md Units). Collapse to the vars only once the foundation
+ // aliases move to rem. See provisional-token audit A-3 / A-4.
  const SPACE_SECTION = '3rem'; // alias/space/section (48px)
  const SIZE_COL_NAV = '8.75rem'; // alias/size/footer/col-width-nav (140px)
```

---

# 4 · Tier 1 newline — `foundation/sizes.ts`

**Current:** commit `d83d20c` on this branch adds a trailing blank line. Your working tree has **already reverted it** (`git diff HEAD` shows `-` on the blank line), it just isn't committed.

**Changed:** commit that revert. `foundation/` then drops out of the PR diff entirely — no CODEOWNERS Tier 1 review request, no `tier1-guard` warning.

content.content:
## Summary

- Scaffold global footer component with responsive four-column desktop layout, tablet/mobile stacked layout, and full dark/inverse theme across all breakpoints
- Add UI kit atoms: `ZimmButton` (primary/secondary/icon variants, large/medium sizes, light/inverse modes), `ZimmNavItem` (underline-on-hover nav link), `ZimmTextInput` (flush floating-label input with hover/filled/focus border states), `ZimmIcon` (centralised SVG icon set)
- Add `ZimmInputAction` molecule — text input with trailing icon-button for subscribe entry point
- Implement subscribe modal (HPC-035, HPC-037): first name, last name, email, privacy consent checkbox — marked as placeholder pending HPC-036 Omneo integration
- Align all atom and footer tokens with Figma design spec (nodes 901:2897, 40000265:374): border colours, floated label colour, inverse error border, spacing tokens, lineHeight overrides
- Add input validation to `ZimmInputAction`: empty-value and email format checks via `checkValidity()`
- Remove self-hosted Futura Round `.woff2` files — Monotype Desktop licence forbids server distribution; font delivery deferred until Zimmermann obtains the Web Page Content entitlement

## Jira

- [SFCC-55](https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-55)
- HPC-035, HPC-037 (subscribe modal fields and privacy consent)
- HPC-036 (Omneo integration — placeholder, not yet implemented)

## Test plan

- [x] Footer renders correctly at mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints
- [x] Subscribe input validates empty and invalid email before opening modal
- [x] Subscribe modal collects first name, last name, and privacy consent
- [x] All buttons (primary, secondary, icon) render correct states: default, hover, focus, disabled, pressed
- [x] ZimmTextInput shows correct border colour per state: default, hover, filled, focused, error
- [x] Floated label colour is `#666` (text.secondary), inverse floated label is `#969696` (text.inverseGrey)
- [x] Storybook stories render without errors for all atoms, molecules, and footer
- [x] No TypeScript errors (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [x] CodeRabbit local review passes with no new findings

## Notes

- `href` values in nav links and contact icons are placeholders — pending Contentful `FooterConfigEntry`
- Locale button is a placeholder — pending locale selector implementation
- Font stack falls back to Century Gothic / Gill Sans until Monotype Web Page Content licence is obtained

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added reusable Zimmermann buttons, icons, logo, navigation items and text inputs.
  * Added email input actions with validation, error states and submit handling.
  * Introduced a responsive footer with navigation, legal links, locale controls and subscription flow.
  * Added light, inverse, disabled, active and focus states across key interface elements.
  * Added accessible icon, logo and form experiences.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved logo rendering and handling of unsafe navigation destinations.

* **Documentation**
  * Added comprehensive interactive examples covering component states and user interactions.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

content.text:
# Fix #13 — Preview vs Figma design-parity review

This one is a **process gate, not a code change** — which is why it's last. The playbook requires that before approving, you compare the running preview against Figma, because nothing automated checks design parity and Zimmermann is exacting about UI (SOW: ≤10 defects, no Sev3).

It hasn't been done. And right now it *can't* be, for three compounding reasons.

---

## Blocker 1 — the preview is stale, and worse than "we haven't pushed"

```
https://zimmermann-pr-f55-ce421bff.sfdc-8tgtt5-ecom1.exp-delivery.com
Built: 2026-08-19T08:33:49Z  ·  Deploy Preview: SUCCESS
```

You said it's outdated because you haven't pushed. It's actually a step further back:

```
git log origin/feature/SFCC-55...HEAD  →  0 unpushed commits
git status                             →  27 modified files
```

**Nothing from this session has been committed at all.** So the preview isn't "missing the latest push" — it predates the entire rework. Absent from it:

- the subscribe state-machine fix and `footer.ts` migration
- the `cssVars.ts` deletion and all 53 call-site migrations
- the `zimmTextInput` recipe rebuild
- the `ContactIconRow` a11y fix
- `PendingSignup` / the `_firstName` cleanup
- **today's z-index fix**

### The consequence that actually bites

**The z-index defect is live in that preview.** Anyone reviewing it right now opens the subscribe modal, sees the sticky header floating over the backdrop, and logs a Sev3 — against a bug you fixed an hour ago. That's a defect counted against your SOW budget for code that no longer exists.

And Storybook won't save you here: `title: 'Layout/Footer'` renders the footer alone, with no header in the tree, so the stacking conflict **cannot manifest there**. This class of bug is only visible in the preview — which is precisely the argument for #13 existing.

---

## Blocker 2 — the automated layer returned no signal

From the last run on `ce421bff`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Unit tests (Vitest) | ✅ SUCCESS |
| Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Branch / Cross-Squad guards | ✅ SUCCESS |
| Deploy Preview | ✅ SUCCESS |
| **Storybook interaction & a11y tests** | ⚠️ **CANCELLED** (ran 91 min) |
| **Playwright E2E (localhost)** | ⚠️ **CANCELLED** (ran 15 min) |
| **Cross-browser E2E (BrowserStack)** | ❌ **FAILURE** |

Every check that could catch a visual or interaction regression either cancelled or failed. Only unit tests passed — and they don't render anything.

BrowserStack's root cause is infrastructure, not your code. It resolved the story key correctly and then died on config resolution:

```
GREP=$(echo "SFCC-55" | tr ' ' '\n' | sed 's/^/@/' | paste -sd '|')
npx browserstack-node-sdk playwright test e2e/tests/zimm --grep "$GREP"
error: Config file does not exist at any parent directory of
```

The two 91-minute and 15-minute cancellations look like timeout or concurrency-group eviction, not assertion failures.

**Worth knowing:** the a11y work from this session (the `ContactIconRow` labelled-span fix) is verified by exactly the job that cancelled. You have no CI evidence for it.

---

## Blocker 3 — the Figma reference is unresolvable

The PR body cites nodes, but **no file URL**:

> *Align all atom and footer tokens with Figma design spec (nodes `901:2897`, `40000265:374`)*

And `footer.ts` cites five more with no file attribution at all:

`40000407-22493` · `40000407-23484` · `40000461:10415` · `40000538:24875` · `40000407:11736`

A node ID without a file key can't be opened. I could only resolve one of them, indirectly — Han's F2R spec identifies `40000265:374` as **TextfieldV2** in `Zimmermann_Design_System_2026` (`wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm`). The five footer nodes are in the 40000407/40000461/40000538 ranges, which may be a different page-design file entirely.

This is the playbook item you flagged verbatim — *"MCP / wrong figma links → ask Jas to rework."* A reviewer cannot verify parity from the PR as it stands.

---

## What "fixing" #13 requires

I can't complete it — it needs a push (which needs a commit, and Hard Rule #15 requires you to ask) and a human eye on two screens. What I can do is clear the blockers and hand you the artefact.

| Step | Who | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Commit + push the 27 files | you (or me, on your say-so) | preview auto-rebuilds — `deploy-preview.yml` is idempotent, same `pr-f55-ce421bff` target |
| 2. Confirm Storybook + Playwright jobs complete | CI | if they cancel again, that's its own finding — currently zero visual/a11y coverage |
| 3. Get the Figma file URL into the PR body | Jas | node IDs alone aren't reviewable |
| 4. Walk the checklist below against the rebuilt preview | you | ~1 hr per the playbook |

---

## The checklist — derived from the code's own Figma claims

Every one of these is an assertion `footer.ts` makes about the design. Each is verifiable against the preview once it rebuilds:

**Layout & spacing**
- [ ] Mobile Content: `px-32 py-48` — node `40000407-22493`
- [ ] Tablet/desktop Content: `pt-64 pb-48 px-40` — node `40000407-23484`
- [ ] Logo area: `px-32 py-48` mobile, `px-40` tablet+
- [ ] Nav column: `flex-col`, `gap-16`, **140px** mobile, auto-width tablet
- [ ] Links row: wrap 2-col mobile → nowrap tablet → `justify-between` desktop
- [ ] Subscribed state container: `py-16`

**Breakpoints** — the highest-risk area, since `desktop` matches no Chakra token
- [ ] 768px (tablet) · 860px (tablet-wide) · **1024px (desktop)**

**Typography**
- [ ] Subscribe heading lineHeight **18px** — node `40000461:10415` (deliberate override of the `navigation` textStyle)
- [ ] Subscribe body font-family = body — node `40000538:24875`
- [ ] Nav headings font-family = body — node `40000407:11736`

**Interaction & a11y** *(none of this is CI-covered right now)*
- [ ] Contact icon touch target **24px** — WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8
- [ ] **Subscribe modal sits above the header** ← the fix you just made; the single most important item
- [ ] Modal focus trap, Escape, focus restore to trigger
- [ ] Contact icons announce as labelled images, not links, and are not tab stops
- [ ] Locale control — accepted as-is; **do not log** the hardcoded label

---

Say the word and I'll commit the 27 files so the preview rebuilds. Otherwise #13 stays blocked on step 1, and the current preview will keep showing a bug that's already dead.
